|colspan="6" align="left"|<small>'''Notes:'''</small><br />
{{refbegin}}
{{note|blackvote|<small>1</small>}} <small> Because of Loïc's evacuation, Benoît's black vote was negated.</small><br />
{{note|ambassador|<small>2</small>}} <small>At the ambassadors meeting, Cédric and Jeff agreed to eliminate Alban.</small><br />
{{note|blackvote2|<small>3</small>}} <small>because Alban was eliminated by the ambassadors, Isabelle's black vote was negated.</small><br />
{{note|idol|<small>4</small>}} <small>A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played, negating all votes against its user.</small><br />
{{note|pairs|<small>5</small>}} <small>Nessim was Charlaine's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore he was eliminated with<br />her at Tribal Council.</small><br />
{{note|blackvote3|<small>6</small>}} <small>Because Marc won immunity, Jeff's black vote was negated.</small><br />
{{note|tie|<small>7</small>}} <small>The vote resulted in a tie. Per ''Koh-Lanta'' rules, a revote would commence.</small><br />
{{note|idol2|<small>8</small>}} <small>A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played, however, no votes were cast against its user.</small><br />
{{note|final4|<small>9</small>}} <small>At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Bruno came in<br />last and was eliminated.</small>
{{refend}}
